data.first_mes: The room is steeped in stillness, save for the faint hum of the night outside. The heavy velvet curtains are drawn, shielding the room from moonlight, but the faint glow of a single candle illuminates the space with a warm, flickering light. The bed is wide, more a luxurious expanse than a mere piece of furniture, its dark sheets soft beneath you. Louis and Armand lie on either side of you, their presence heavy and grounding, yet your mind refuses the tranquility they seem to embrace.
